name: Vercel
description_en:
Vercel is a managed application delivery and runtime platform. Its current site includes agent infrastructure as well as web-app deployment, content delivery and server-side functions. This profile evaluates the Git-to-deployment path, environments, operational rollback and cost controls; it does not merge v0, every AI product and the underlying open-source frameworks into one entitlement.

A developer can import a repository, configure its framework/root/build settings and environment variables, then obtain deployments linked to commits and branches. A successful build alone does not prove application behavior, data isolation or a safe recovery path. No repository was connected and no deployment was made for this research.
description_zh:
Vercel 是托管应用交付及运行平台。当前官网同时介绍 Agent 基础设施、网页应用部署、内容分发及服务端函数。本文研究 Git 到部署、环境、运行回滚及费用控制，不把 v0、全部 AI 产品与底层开源框架合并为一项服务权益。

开发者可导入仓库，配置框架／根目录／构建及环境变量，再取得对应提交与分支的部署。构建成功不能单独证明应用行为、数据隔离或恢复安全。本次未连接仓库或执行部署。

review_notes: Original AI research draft based on the cited public official pages; no publication, price approval, independent review or product test is implied.
Earlier third-party feature and price claims are retained only in discovery provenance, not as current product evidence.

sections.title_en: Track a deployment back to its configuration and commit
sections.en: Import a repository, choose the root directory and framework preset, review build output settings and supply environment variables. Subsequent branch pushes can create previews; the configured production branch creates production deployments. For private organization/group repositories, author membership and linked Git identities can affect whether a commit deploys; Hobby cannot deploy those private organization repositories. When evaluating a small application, compare the expected SHA and returned deployment before testing a read/write route. Branch names alone do not identify an immutable build.
sections.zh: 导入仓库后选择根目录、框架预设，检查构建输出并提供环境变量。后续分支推送可生成预览，配置的生产分支生成生产部署。私有组织／群组仓库的提交能否部署受作者成员资格及 Git 身份关联影响；Hobby 不能部署这些私有组织仓库。评估小应用时，应先比对预期 SHA 与部署，再测试读写路由；分支名不能唯一标识不可变构建。

sections.title_en: The first deployment is a documented production exception
sections.title_zh: 首次部署有生产环境例外
sections.en: The current environment guide says a new project’s first deployment is always Production, even from a nonproduction branch or a CLI preview target. It uses Production variables, not Preview-only values. An errored/canceled first deployment still counts; later deployments follow ordinary preview rules. Deleting every deployment resets the first-deployment condition. Use isolated data credentials for evaluation. A staged production build also uses production configuration, so a generated URL is not proof that its database or external effects are isolated.
sections.zh: 当前环境指南明确：新项目首次部署始终为 Production，即使来自非生产分支或 CLI 预览目标，也使用 Production 变量，而非仅配置于 Preview 的值。首次出错／取消仍计数，后续才按通常预览规则；删除所有部署会重置首次条件。评估应使用隔离数据凭据。暂存生产构建同样使用生产配置，生成 URL 不能证明数据库及外部副作用隔离。

sections.title_en: Request completion and durable work are different scopes
sections.title_zh: 请求完成与持久任务范围不同
sections.en: Functions serve request-driven APIs, webhooks and streamed responses, with regional placement near data sources. The documentation’s waitUntil example returns HTTP202 while follow-up work runs. An accepted response therefore is not an independently observed completion receipt. For work that must preserve progress across pauses or deployments, the page points to Workflows or eve. Choose the runtime/limits for the actual application and test failures in both the request and downstream operation; no duration or recovery guarantee is inferred from automatic scaling.
sections.zh: Functions 用于请求驱动 API、webhook 及流式响应，可将区域靠近数据源。文档 waitUntil 示例在后续工作运行时返回 HTTP202，因此接受响应不是已独立观察的完成凭证。需跨暂停或部署保留进度时，页面指向 Workflows 或 eve。应按真实应用选择运行时／限制，分别测试请求与下游操作失败；自动扩缩容不能证明时限或恢复保证。

sections.title_en: Rollback restores a build, not external state
sections.title_zh: 回滚恢复构建，不能据此恢复外部状态
sections.en: Instant Rollback points production domains to an eligible previous production build; ordinary previews are not eligible. Hobby can return to the immediately previous deployment, while paid plans have broader eligible history. The old configuration and environment values can be stale, and databases/APIs may have changed independently. After rollback, automatic assignment of production domains is disabled, so a later push does not automatically replace it until a deployment is promoted to undo rollback. Test recovery with compatible data changes; no rollback was exercised.
sections.zh: Instant Rollback 将生产域名指向符合条件的旧生产构建，普通预览不符合。Hobby 可回到紧邻的旧部署，付费方案可选更广历史。旧配置及环境值可能过时，数据库／API 可能已独立变化。回滚后会关闭生产域名自动分配，后续推送不会自动替换，直至通过提升部署撤销回滚。需结合兼容数据变更测试恢复；本次未执行回滚。

sections.title_en: A plan price is not the entire runtime bill
sections.title_zh: 方案价不等于完整运行账单
sections.en: The current USD view lists Hobby $0/month for personal noncommercial use, Pro $20/month with a $20 included usage credit, and custom Enterprise. Taxes are extra. Functions, storage and other resources have separate meters; AI products and add-ons need their own sizing. Hobby has usage caps and cannot buy additional usage, while Pro supports on-demand usage. Treat the headline as an entry point, then confirm seats, applicable resource rates and integrations against a representative workload; no all-in monthly figure was calculated.
sections.zh: 当前美元页面列 Hobby 每月 $0，限个人非商业用途；Pro 每月 $20，含 $20 用量抵扣；Enterprise 询价，税另计。函数、存储等资源分别计量，AI 产品及附加项需单独核算。Hobby 有用量上限，不能增购；Pro 支持按需用量。应以标题价为起点，按代表工作量确认席位、资源费率及集成，不据此计算完整月账单。

sections.title_en: Spend alerts are not an instantaneous universal cap
sections.title_zh: 费用提醒不是即时通用硬上限
sections.en: Spend Management applies to metered team resources, excluding seats, integrations and separate add-ons. Setting a budget alone does not stop usage. Optional pausing stops every project’s production traffic and returns503, but checks occur every few minutes. AI Gateway keys, v0 and stored resources can continue accruing charges. Raising the budget does not automatically resume projects; each needs resumption. These detailed conditions qualify the pricing page’s broad stop-before-over-budget wording. Decide how to handle lost availability and residual charges before relying on automatic pausing.
sections.zh: Spend Management 针对团队计量资源，不含席位、集成及独立附加项；仅设置预算不会停止用量。可选暂停会停止所有项目生产流量并返回503，但每几分钟才检查。AI Gateway key、v0 及保留存储仍可能计费，提高预算也不会自动恢复项目，需逐项恢复。这些详细条件限定定价页广义的超预算前停止宣传。依赖自动暂停前需明确不可用及残余费用处理。
